observations.body: Paul imagines extraordinary speech, knowledge, generosity, suffering, and all faith, then says they amount to nothing without love.
observations.label: Faith that moves mountains can still lack love

payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 13:1–13 as evidence about faith, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: Faith is not treated as the only measure of a community’s maturity.
